desc: A suite of tools for fantasy football players
readme_head:
# Fantasy Tools > We strive to bring fantasy sports players a suite of tools to evaluate past performance and improve future results with unique data-driven simulations. https://fantasytools.dev

# Development Built with [create-react-app](https://github.com/facebookincubator/create-react-app) Run with: `npm run start` Units tests: `npm test` E2E tests: `npm run cypress:open`
